product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving is an all-in-one business management platform that helps fitness, wellness, and beauty businesses manage bookings, staff, payments, marketing, and client engagement.

founded_year.notes: The company’s own funding announcement states 2013; PitchBook lists 2012. The primary company statement is used here.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is business-growth, customer-story, product, and release content; engineering-leadership profiles do not constitute an engineer-authored technical blog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live AI Solutions Engineer posting describes building AI workflows, copilots, LLM systems, and agentic automations.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly identified as powering the Isaac support assistant; this does not establish the provider behind CAASI.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 report and third-party HIPAA audits are claimed. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not standalone certifications. ISO 27001 is attributed to AWS; PCI DSS attestations are attributed to payment-processing partners.

value.stage: Minority growth-equity investment and debt financing

last_funding.notes: Announced August 16, 2022: $46 million minority investment led by McCarthy Capital plus $20 million growth financing from CIBC. The $66 million is the combined financing round.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest identified funding was announced August 16, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the article’s 2026 update is not a new round.

launched_6mo.notes: July 28, 2026 announcement of general availability for CAASI Chat Agent and Phone Agent falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jay Hedges’s profile dates his start as VP Sales at WellnessLiving to July 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named in sales operations; Salesforce and HubSpot are named as examples in the revenue-stack posting; the enablement posting requests hands-on Salesforce and Gong experience. These are visible hiring signals, not a verified exhaustive deployment inventory.
